notes.title: Patch Notes ver. 1.01 : Balancing & Bugs
notes.notes: [p]We have our first update, fixing some minor bugs having to do with correct languages displaying, and some balancing, especially in Black Ice.[/p][list][*][p]fixed issues where in some situations if language was set to something other than English, text might not appear, or might revert back to default.[/p][/*][*][p]balancing for Black Ice 2 : making things easier on Worm/Beetle modes[/p][/*][*][p]balancing for Black Ice 3, room 2 : slight redesign of room, and made easier / less chaotic.[/p][/*][*][p]balancing for all worlds : a few other rooms (mainly final rooms) have slightly less enemy spawns as well.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks![/p][p]D.S.[/p]

notes.title: Dragenas Out Now!
